name: Changelog Enforcer
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled]
    branches:
      - master
      - main

jobs:
  enforce-changelog:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

yaml:
name: Changelog Enforcer
on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, labeled, unlabeled]
    branches:
      - master
      - main

jobs:
  enforce-changelog:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: dangoslen/changelog-enforcer@v3
        with:
          skipLabels: documentation
